$comment: Card styles of the Monolith Realms set (Planar Horizons capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/planar-horizons.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: Monumental fantasy oil painting in muted slate, ochre and bone tones: awe-inspiring architectural scale, tiny distant birds for proportion, moody overcast drama.
rules: These are full-art pictures for playing cards: the client draws a small name plate over the top edge, mana symbols at the top right and power and toughness at the bottom right, so keep the main subject in the middle of the panel and the top 15% and bottom 15% calm and uncluttered (sky, ground, water, background texture), with nothing important in the corners. Each panel shows its own subject as one clear, readable scene, the same style and palette as its neighbours, as if the whole row were a matched, limited-edition art series.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a vast echoing limestone cavern lit by a pale shaft of daylight over an underground river and carved alcoves

items.subject: a vast echoing limestone cavern lit by a pale shaft of daylight over an underground river and carved alcoves
a grand circular colonnade of marble pillars opening onto a deep starry night chasm
a colossal weathered iron ribcage half-sunk in black marsh water under heavy pewter clouds
a towering subterranean vault of dark obsidian pillars and dim bronze braziers stacked with ancient chests
an amorphous shifting stone bastion whose arched walls subtly resemble wings, antlers and shields

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
